basic_info.description: Victorian charm meets modern magic in the heart of Duboce Triangle! Germania St. is a beautiful, quiet street nestled at the intersection of Hayes Valley and Duboce Triangle. The location is steps away from Duboce Park, a short walk to both Alamo Square & the Castro. This stunning townhouse-style condo seamlessly blends Victorian elegance with modern convenience, making it the ultimate urban retreat.    Step inside to dramatic, soaring ceilings, intricate moldings, & a perfect balance of old-world grace & contemporary ease. The home boasts three bedrooms, 2.5 modern bathrooms, a private office, & a sleek, updated kitchen that's as functional as it is stylish. The large dining room flows effortlessly into the kitchen, which spills onto a deckperfect for morning coffee or evening cocktails.    The upper level features a bright & airy primary ensuite with a deck & an attractive additional bedroom, while the generous lower level, constructed in 2016 with concrete foundations & full permits, offers a spacious bedroom & a flexible office/bonus room.    Just steps from Duboce Park, Haight Street, Divisadero's hottest spots, the vibrant Castro, and frequent transit, this home is where convenience meets character. Walk Score 99, Transit Score 100.
